title: 24 January 1947 — Rights, Minorities and the Advisory Committee
summary: The Assembly creates the Advisory Committee on fundamental rights, minorities and tribal/excluded areas, debates representation and election procedure, and later adopts its own budget.

title: Advisory Committee — Rights, Minorities and Tribal Areas
summary: Pant moves the committee that will develop proposals on fundamental rights, minority safeguards and tribal/excluded areas; the House then reshapes its membership and procedure.

title: Adivasi Representation — Jaipal Singh
summary: Jaipal Singh challenges the distribution and adequacy of tribal representation, including omissions of communities and tribal women.

title: Committee Selection — Named List or Proportional Representation?
summary: The Assembly disputes whether committee membership should be elected by proportional representation or constituted through a negotiated named list.

title: Assembly Administrative Autonomy
summary: After the budget is adopted, the President states that Constituent Assembly employees are not government servants and that the Assembly may make its own service rules.
